name: TimeInput
description:
A time of day typed as people write it ("930", "9:30pm", "21:30", "noon") or picked from a
list, shown in the locale's clock ("9:30 am" in en-AU) and held as `HH:mm`. Arrow keys step
the part under the caret (minutes by `step`), Page Up and Page Down move an hour, Home and
End go to min and max, and Alt+↓ opens the list. Text that is not a time (or is outside
min/max) turns the box invalid; the text is tidied on blur.
signature: ({ value, defaultValue, onValueChange, onReject, locale: localeProp, hourCycle, seconds, min, max, step, suggestions, popup, size, width, placeholder, disabled, readOnly, invalid, required, name, id, onBlur, className, ref, ...aria }: TimeInputProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name when a visible label does not name the control.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: IDs of elements that provide the accessible name.

props.name: className
props.description: Layout only. Applied to the control box.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial time when uncontrolled.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables interaction while retaining the component’s disabled appearance.

props.name: hourCycle
props.description: Override the locale's clock: 12 (am/pm) or 24.

props.name: id
props.description: A stable element or component identifier.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Invalid outside a Field. Text that is not a time marks the field invalid by itself.

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale: the clock and its am/pm words. Default: the nearest `LocaleProvider`, then `configureLocale()`, then `<html lang>`, then en-US.

props.name: max
props.description: Latest allowed time.

props.name: min
props.description: Earliest allowed time.

props.name: name
props.description: The component’s name or native form field name, as specified by its value type.

props.name: onBlur
props.description: Called when the text input loses focus, after the typed time has been committed.

props.name: onReject
props.description:
Called on blur or Enter instead of `onValueChange` when the text cannot be read (with the text
as typed) or reads as a time outside min/max (with that time). The box is marked invalid.
The bound TimeField passes it to the form so `timeSchema` can explain it.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with a time, or null when the field is emptied. Typing commits on blur or Enter; arrow keys and the list commit at once.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: The prompt while empty. Default: the format in the locale's clock ("h:mm am").

props.name: popup
props.description: Show the list button (default true). Typing and arrow keys work without it.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Displays the current value without allowing edits.

props.name: ref
props.description: Receives the underlying element for focus or measurement. React 19 accepts ref as a normal prop.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the input required for assistive technology; pair it with `timeSchema({ required: true })`.

props.name: seconds
props.description: Hold seconds (`HH:mm:ss`). Default false.

props.name: size
props.description: The box height, matching DateField.

props.name: step
props.description: Minutes between suggested times, and between arrow-key steps on the minutes (default 15).

props.name: suggestions
props.description: Explicit times to offer in the list instead of every `step` minutes.

props.name: value
props.description: A time of day (`09:30`, or `09:30:15` with `seconds`), or null when empty. A value that is not a time is shown as it is and marked invalid.

props.name: width
props.description: Content width (R15.6). Default short: a time is about eight characters.
